origin.lens: compile-options twin: mutants compiled unchecked while the build was checked

description: The same source as fifthway-d1 with CheckForOverflowUnderflow=true, and a witness that expects the caught overflow. Before the legs took the build's options every mutant was compiled UNCHECKED, so the overflow case killed all of them for a reason the shipped brick does not have (wrap instead of throw): manufactured kills. The mutants must compile checked, and the record must say so.
